facts: IETF ChaCha20-Poly1305 is available through native cipher/decipher with a16byte tag.
AAD precedes update; encryption tag is read after final.
Authenticated decryption may emit unauthenticated bytes from update; final must authenticate before publication.
Runtime support varies with the Node/OpenSSL build.
Existing pinned HChaCha routine accepts sigma/key/nonce/output Uint32Array words.
Existing XChaCha AEAD ciphertext contains a16byte appended authentication tag.
Derive a32byte subkey using HChaCha with the first16nonce bytes.
The IETF ChaCha20-Poly1305 nonce is four zero bytes followed by the final eight original nonce bytes.
Public HChaCha and AEAD test vectors are implemented as exact byte interoperability checks.

limitations: No claim that this expired Internet-Draft is a new finalized standard.
No change to the existing Large Cyst format, AAD, random24byte nonce prefix, HMAC, wrapping or recovery keys.
Buffer wiping covers retained JavaScript buffers; no guarantee about copies internal to OpenSSL or the garbage collector.
